description_en: Searches for news based on your input. This feature is currently limited to web search
description_zh: 根据输入检索新闻，目前仅支持互联网搜索
kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi search-news --agent-key xxxxx_p_efm --search-sources QuarkCommonNews --query '检索Query' --page-size 10 --page 1 --include-content false --filter-not-null false --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchNews

parameters.description_en: The unique ID of the workspace. For more information, see [AgentKey](~~3027170~~).
parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the workspace. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3027170.html
parameters.name: agent_key

parameters.description_en: The number of records to return on each page. The default value is 10.
parameters.help_en: The number of records to return on each page. The default value is 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: The page number. The default value is 1.
parameters.help_en: The page number. The default value is 1

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include the full text of the article
parameters.name: include_content

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to filter out results with empty content.
